Lead 2026-10-04 (slice 5): option (a). The real backend recomputes a document run that has no bound archive, on the same revision and dataset revision, through the normal prepared-study and runner path. Conditions:
- Provenance marks such a result as recomputed (not the original computation) with the eyes4s version that produced it, so a run first made by an older library is never silently presented as original.
- Once a run's archive binding is bound, a recomputed archive whose digest differs is refused with a typed error naming both digests.
- Recomputation is cached per run, and progress is visible through the normal job surface.
